# Saturday long run: moving

The boathouse car park closes for building work from January, so the Saturday 9am long run needs a new start point and probably a new time.

- Start point: not chosen. The leisure centre and the park gate are the two we have thought of.
- Time: 9am now. The park gate is locked until 8:30 on Saturdays.
- Route: the current 14 km loop starts at the boathouse and would have to change if the start moves.
